title: Biomarkers and Emerging Approaches in Gastroenteropancreatic Neuroendocrine Neoplasms (GEP-NEN): Current Evidence and Future Directions.
snippet: Gastroenteropancreatic neuroendocrine neoplasms (GEP-NENs) comprise a biologically and clinically heterogeneous spectrum of tumors with substantial inter- and intratumoral variability.
